title: Notification for interview of Asst Public Prosecutor Notification for interview of Asst Public Prosecutor 09/11/2026 16/11/2026 View (123 KB)
text:
KEY LINES:
9(10)/DM/SPJ/LAW/Vol-IV/2024/I/1600304/2026, dated 09/09/2026 for appointment of
the Board of Selection Committee on 17/11/2025 at 11.00 AM at the Office of the District

FULL TEXT:
No. F. 9(10)/DM/SPJ/LAW/Vol-IV/2024
GOVERNMENT OF TRIPURA
OFFICE OF THE DISTRICT MAGISTRATE & COLLECTOR
SEPAHIJALA DISTRICT, BISHRAMGANJ
(Law Cell)
NOTIFICATION
With reference to the advertisement vide No.
9(10)/DM/SPJ/LAW/Vol-IV/2024/I/1600304/2026, dated 09/09/2026 for appointment of
Asstt. Public Prosecutors, all the intending candidates are hereby requested to appear before
the Board of Selection Committee on 17/11/2025 at 11.00 AM at the Office of the District
Magistrate & Collector, Sepahijala District, Bishramganj with the following terms and
condition.
Terms and Conditions:
1. All the applicants are requested to bring their all-relevant original documents & along
with passport size photo on the date and time of interview.
2. Date and time of the Interview are fixed and the applicants should appear on the
scheduled date and time.
3. No separate call letters for interview will be issued to any applicant.
4. No TA/DA will be provided to any applicant for appearing in the interview.
5. The date of interview if changed due to certain emergent conditions, all the intending
candidates are hereby advised to keep visiting website: http://sepahijala.nic.in and
the Notice board of the O/o the DM & Collector, Sepahijala District, Bishramganj and
the SDM’s Office of Bishalgarh, Sonamura & Jampuijala.
Details of the notification are available in http://sepahijala.nic.in and the Notice
board of the O/o the DM & Collector, Sepahijala District, Bishramganj and the SDM’s Office
of Bishalgarh, Sonamura & Jampuijala.
District Magistrate & Collector,
Sepahijala District, Bishramganj.
Copy to:
1. PS to the LR & Secretary, Law Department, Govt. of Tripura for kind information
to the LR & Secretary, Law Department, Govt. of Tripura.
2. The Director, ICA Department, Govt. of Tripura for information with request to
publish the same at least in 5 (five) leading local dailies within 02(two) days after
received of the notification.
3. The DIO, NIC, Sepahijala District for information with request to upload the
Notification in the web portal of District Administration, Sepahijala.
